display_long_description:
SkiingRush VR is a fast-paced virtual reality skiing experience focused on speed, flow, and progression.

Ride down snowy mountains in full VR, carve through sharp turns, avoid obstacles, and push your limits to collect as many Ice Crystals as possible. Every run challenges your control, timing, and balance as you race through dynamic downhill slopes.

Ice Crystals are the key to progression. Collect them during your runs to unlock new maps, each with unique terrain, steeper slopes, and more demanding routes. The further you go, the faster and more intense the experience becomes.

Designed for smooth performance on Meta Quest, SkiingRush VR offers intuitive controls, satisfying movement, and a constant sense of momentum that keeps every run exciting.

🔥 Key Features

High-speed VR skiing with responsive, body-lean-based controls

Ice Crystal collection system to unlock new maps

Multiple downhill environments with increasing difficulty

Fast, replayable runs focused on skill and progression

Optimized for Meta Quest standalone VR

Easy to start, challenging to master

Feel the speed. Collect the crystals. Unlock the mountain.
